title: history of space travel, i guess

lines.say: beep. beep. that's it. that's the first satellite.
nineteen fifty seven. the soviets throw a metal ball into space, and it just beeps.
for three weeks. then the battery dies.
then a stray dog from moscow goes up. her name is laika.
nineteen sixty one. yuri gagarin says let's go, and goes around the whole planet.
he's home in under two hours.
nineteen sixty nine. two guys land on the moon and plant a flag.
when they leave, the engine blows the flag over.
twelve people walk on the moon. then, nineteen seventy two, everyone just stops.
twenty twenty six. four people fly all the way back, and just drive past it.
two thousand. people move into a space station. it's never been empty since.
it laps the planet about sixteen times a day. sixteen sunrises. sleeping is weird.
two thousand fifteen. a rocket comes back down and lands. standing up.
now they catch them with giant chopsticks.
so if you're under twenty six, there's never been a day without people in space.
and it all started with a beep.
